qualifications: endings "native": CRLF on Windows (equal to Windows Chromium 610d0a620d0a630d0a64), LF elsewhere; the fixture asserts the platform value.

Native FileReader engine object not exposed; loader path missing (the host loader has no blob-URL path). Blob.text/arrayBuffer/bytes promises are not bound. Reads, text, data URLs and cancellation are managed over rv_blob_read_bytes.
Native reads copy the bytes on the host work queue after ReadBytes returns; Chromium reads through FileReader.readAsArrayBuffer. Cancel before delivery gives Cancelled on both.
Blob.slice takes int64 arguments; the [Clamp] conversion of fractional JavaScript numbers (slice(1.9, 4.2)) is browser-only.
Under Fable, int64/uint64 members (Blob.size, File.lastModified, Blob.slice) are converted between BigInt and number by generated Emit adapters (native e202b57).
Native wrappers of Blob, File and FileList reject use after host disposal (ObjectDisposedException); the native handles themselves outlive rv_host_destroy (native probe heldPastDestroy).
Invalid UTF-8 in a native string blob part returns RV_ERR_NULL_ARGUMENT; managed callers write USVStrings as UTF-8 with U+FFFD for lone surrogates.
URL.createObjectURL/revokeObjectURL and Blob.stream are out of H11 scope (blob-URL loading after H13; streams are H12).
FCS on Ranvier.View.Dom reports the pre-existing Debug.fs:985 Trace.snapshot errors (the traced Debug configuration), as H01 recorded; Debug.fs is unchanged by H11.
Win-x64 only; Linux and macOS not run locally (native Linux CI step added in build.yml).
